sources.title: Supertonic 3 — Lightning-Fast, On-Device, Multilingual TTS
sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 is a 99M-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model from Supertone. Runs on CPU via ONNX Runtime. No GPU. No cloud. No API. 31 languages.

sources.title: GitHub - supertone-inc/supertonic: Lightning-Fast, On-Device ...
sources.snippet: Supertonic is a lightning-fast, on-device multilingual text-to-speech system designed for local inference with minimal overhead. Powered by ONNX Runtime, it runs entirely on your device—no cloud, no API calls, no privacy concerns.

sources.title: sebylg5/supertonic-3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: What's New in Supertonic 3 31 languages: expanded from the 5-language Supertonic 2 release. More stable reading: fewer repeat and skip failures, especially on short and long utterances. Higher speaker similarity: improved similarity across the shared-language set compared with Supertonic 2.

sources.title: Supertonic 3 — Models — The AI Bench
sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 expands the open-weight release from 5 to 31 languages, improves reading stability, and cuts repeat/skip failures. `pip install supertonic` and synthesize immediately with selectable voice styles.
